modules.module_title: Check the exterior of the tube trailer

pcs.pc_description: conduct a thorough walk-around inspection of the trailer to ensure roadworthiness, noting any visible cracks, dents, leaks, loose connections or damage to the trailer body, frame, and welds
visually inspect the valves, connections, and pressure gauges
inspect for proper tire pressure, tread wear, and any cuts, bulges, or foreign objects lodged in the tire tread, loose lug nuts, cracks, or damage to the wheel rims
test the brakes for proper operation and ensure the parking brake is functional
listen for air leaks and ensure brake lights activate when the pedal is pressed
check all headlights, taillights, brake lights, turn signals, hazard lights, and reflectors are clean, functional, and correctly aligned
ensure fire extinguishers are appropriately mounted and charged, reflective triangles and warning signs are readily accessible, and spill containment kit is present and complete
check that the trailer is properly grounded using the dedicated grounding cable and wheel chocks
verify whether all hazardous material signs and labels are clean, undamaged, and clearly visible
ensure that windshield, windows, and mirrors are clean for better visuals
ensure that there are no flammable items, greasy rags or bottled fuel in the vehicle
check trailer security by performing a 'tug test' or chocking wheels and the free play test to check the steering
ensure that proper warning signs are fixed in the trailer according to regulations, e.g., a 'highly inflammable' warning sign in the form of a Tape or Plate having a retro-reflective background

modules.module_title: Examine the interior of the trailer

pcs.pc_description: confirm that pressure relief valves are sealed
ensure that all pressure gauges are functioning correctly and displaying accurate readings
visually inspect all valves and connections for leaks, damage, or loose fittings
use appropriate tools to tighten any loose connections
check for wear, cracks, or leaks in all hoses and piping, ensuring proper routing and secure connections
check the fuel gauge for fuel availability
check fire extinguishers, alarms, and emergency shutdown systems regularly
examine each cylinder or tube for signs of damage, corrosion, or any anomalies
verify that cylinders are securely fastened to the trailer and aligned properly
ensure that all seals are intact and adequately seated to prevent gas leaks
verify pressure readings on all gaseous hydrogen tanks are within acceptable range (20- 60 MPa) as per the manufacturer's specifications/ SOP
ensure the tow vehicle is compatible with the weight and specifications of the Green Hydrogen Tube Trailer
verify whether all essential permits and licenses for transporting hazardous materials are current and available

ensure that the trailer registration, fitness certification, insurance documents, copy of registration certificate, road tax and trip/cargo- related documents like MSDS, e-way bill, trip sheet, delivery orders, etc., are available
record all pre-operation checks in a designated logbook, noting any discrepancies or concerns
report actual or possible defects to the service/ transportation supervisor in enough detail so they can diagnose the problem

modules.module_title: Safely drive the green hydrogen tube trailer

pcs.pc_description: start the green hydrogen tube trailer in accordance with manufacturer guidelines
operate all controls, including brakes, accelerator, and steering, to maneuver the trailer under various conditions
change gear smoothly in coordination with steering control and acceleration
adhere to all traffic laws and regulations specific to transporting hazardous materials
perform various defensive driving techniques regarding overtaking, parking, stopping, driving in the rain, driving at night, etc, wherever required
overtake other road users legally, safely and by using the correct signalling
maintain appropriate speed and distance from other vehicles, taking into account the characteristics of transporting green hydrogen
follow precautions and road signs to avoid roll over, braking hazards and possible accidents
use indicators, horn and arm signals to signal as per the traffic requirements
engage parking brakes when parking the trailer, especially on gradients
follow the guidelines of the organization if the vehicle breaks down and respond accordingly
avoid idling the engine beyond a reasonable limit

modules.module_title: Navigate diverse routes and adapt to changing conditions

pcs.pc_description: utilize navigation tools like Google Maps and NavIC accurately, accounting for potential route closures or deviations
communicate route plans, estimated arrival times and delays to relevant personnel
maintain awareness of restricted zones and check the availability of necessary permits for specific routes
adapt driving strategies to different terrains and weather conditions, ensuring safe and efficient travel

refrain from aggressive driving practices such as tailgating, speeding, or sudden lane changes
change lanes safely at appropriate speed and observe traffic conditions
ensure there are no incoming bikes, pedestrians, or other traffic while opening the door of the trailer
maintain composure and react calmly in emergencies such as tyre blowouts, brake failures, hydrogen leaks or vehicle breakdown
monitor critical indicators, such as pressure gauges, temperature sensors, and brake performance, during operation
report any incidents, accidents, breakdowns, etc., during driving, if any, to the supervisor/authorized person

modules.module_title: Maintain personal health and fitness for safe driving

pcs.pc_description: maintain adequate physical fitness and stamina to handle the physical demands of driving and operating the trailer
avoid eating and drinking while driving
plan for rest stops at regular intervals and get sufficient sleep within prescribed limits to avoid fatigue and to remain alert while driving
stay calm and composed during difficult situations like traffic jams, accidents and strictly avoid any argument with fellow commuters and other public
report any health concerns that may affect driving ability or safety to supervisors immediately
avoid driving under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or medication that may impair judgment or reaction time

modules.module_title: Practice safe work procedures and hazard prevention

pcs.pc_description: securely fasten seat belts and avoid distractions while driving
ensure that loading does not exceed the manufacturer's specifications and legal limits

use appropriate PPE, such as safety goggles/face shield, chemical-resistant gloves, flame-resistant high-visibility clothing, safety shoes/boots and respiratory protection during maintenance and emergencies
confirm the availability of a basic first aid kit in the trailer cabin
manage emergency firefighting situations during transit, such as handling electrical fires, hydrogen fires, etc., prioritizing self-safety
respond to a fire and use appropriate firefighting equipment

modules.module_title: Respond effectively to emergencies and incidents

pcs.pc_description: remain calm and follow emergency response procedures in case of hydrogen leaks, fires, or accidents
evacuate the area and notify authorities immediately, providing accurate information about the incident
assist emergency personnel and cooperate with investigations as required

modules.module_title: Maintain a safe and clean vehicle

ensure proper ventilation and drainage within the trailer cabin to avoid moisture buildup and foul odour
report any unsafe working conditions or near misses to supervisors for corrective action
